title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > CD-Wave > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 2496
source: 3x Nakamichi CM300's > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII-S. Set up in the row of tapers directly behind the soundboard

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Maine show with stellar Jerry solos and a solid recording that’s “okay” but still very listenable
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this 9/17/82 Portland, ME concert as one of the best they’ve heard – Bertha opens the night, a blistering Morning Dew solo, sweet Deal, a darkly foreboding Estimated Prophet and a killer Dew‑>Sugar finish. The tape’s sound quality is described only as “okay,” with no major flaws noted, making it a worthwhile listen despite not being a pristine soundboard.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave 5‑star ratings and praised the performance heavily; recording quality is only modestly commented on, so the overall rating leans toward a strong show with decent audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the quality as “okay” – no specific issues or source details mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opener with Bertha and a high‑impact closing sequence (Dew > Sugar), with standout moments throughout the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple mentions of blistering, first‑class solos (Morning Dew, Deal) and overall top performance all night.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Weir) pulled his A‑game alongside Jerry.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent did not sing this night; no specific keyboard playing comments.
